findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "invoice_json_composite" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Convert raw invoice text into structured JSON: number, dates, currency, line items, totals and consistency checks" → after: "Convert raw invoice text into structured JSON: number, dates, currency, line items, totals and consistency checks. Use when you need to extract structured data from raw invoice text: number, dates, currency, line items and totals, with consistency checks. Example input: {"text":"Invoice 1042 ... Tot"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
